name: Continue
tagline: Open-source IDE extension for VS Code and JetBrains that connects local LLMs for autocomplete and inline code edits.
real_test_summary: Tested connecting Ollama models inside VS Code for tab autocomplete and inline refactoring. Delivers low-latency local code suggestions without sending proprietary files to external servers.
pros: Native extensions for both VS Code and JetBrains IDEs
Supports separate local models for fast tab autocomplete and deep chat
Apache-2.0 open-source license with granular context providers
cons: Requires configuring an external local runner like Ollama or LM Studio
Large codebase indexing increases background RAM usage
